title: Support the Movement
summary: BetterLimay is volunteer-run and free for the people of Limay. Here is how you can help, and how to reach us for collaboration.
body:
BetterLimay is an independent, volunteer-run portal that puts Limay's public services, officials and records in one place, and names the source of every figure. It costs the people of Limay nothing, and it is built in the open.

A resident should not need to know which office to ask, or which Facebook page to scroll, to find out what a service requires, who represents their barangay, or how public money was spent. That is the gap BetterLimay is trying to close, and it cannot be closed by a few people.

## How you can help

- **Collaborate with us.** For partnerships, volunteering, research, design, translation into Filipino, or local knowledge, and for offices and organisations who want to work with us, email **[volunteer.betterlimay@gmail.com](mailto:volunteer.betterlimay@gmail.com)**.
- **Share public records.** If you hold an ordinance, a directory, a charter or any other public document about Limay, see the [guide to submitting Limay data](/contribute#submit-data).
- **Tell us what is wrong.** Found a mistake or something out of date? Use [Report an issue](/report).
- **Build with us.** The whole site is open source on [GitHub](https://github.com/AstroMC98/BetterLimay-Prod).
- **Spread the word.** Share BetterLimay with your family, your barangay and your organisation.

Every contribution is reviewed against its source before it is published, and credited if you wish.

Questions or ideas? Write to **[volunteer.betterlimay@gmail.com](mailto:volunteer.betterlimay@gmail.com)**.

provenance.verification_note: An update from the BetterLimay team, not an announcement of the Municipality of Limay.
